item.title: THE LAST OF US Expected To End After Season 3 According To HBO Boss
item.description: Though nothing has been made official, HBO's Casey Bloys has indicated that the upcoming third season of The Last of Us will serve as the acclaimed adaptation's final run...

item.title: HIGHLANDER Set Photos Reunite JUSTICE LEAGUE Stars Henry Cavill And Jeremy Irons
item.description: Chad Stahelski's Highlander reboot has been shooting at the Tower of London, and new set photos put the spotlight on Henry Cavill, Jeremy Irons, and a big action scene.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Action Figures And Promo Art Reveal New Look At Beast Man
item.description: A first look at some action figures from a smaller wave of Masters of the Universe action figures reveal new looks at the character designs for He-man, Teela, and Beast Man...

item.title: WONDER MAN Poll & Spoiler Discussion: How Would You Rate The Latest MCU TV Series?
item.description: It's been nearly a week since Wonder Man premiered on Disney+, and now, we want you to cast your vote and rate the latest Marvel Television series.

item.title: SEND HELP Wins Weekend Box Office As X-MEN Director Brett Ratner's Comeback, MELANIA, Overperforms
item.description: Sam Raimi's Send Help managed to emerge as the big winner at the U.S. box office this weekend, but all anyone can talk about is the surprise success of Melania.

item.title: THUNDERBOLTS* Star Olga Kurylenko Responds To Fans Who Want #JusticeForTaskmaster (Exclusive)
item.description: Talking to us about her role in Misdirection, Black Widow star Olga Kurylenko responds to the support she's received from fans following Taskmaster's demise in Thunderbolts*.

item.title: Marvel's Comics Giveaway Day Titles Include An Insane First Look At Chip Zdarsky's ARMAGEDDON Event
item.description: This May, Marvel Comics celebrates Free Comic Book Day Comics Giveaway Day with previews of Armageddon, Amazing Spider-Man #1000, the return of Doctor Doom, and more.

item.title: Marvel Skipping Super Bowl 2026: No AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Trailer Expected
item.description: We've finally learned about some of the TV spots and trailers coming during next weekend's Super Bowl, but it sounds like Marvel Studios will be giving the Big Game a wide berth in 2026.

item.title: Will Orko Make His Live-Action Debut In MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE? New Rumor Reveals Answer
item.description: Orko was missing from 1987's Masters of the Universe movie, but will the fan-favourite Trollan make his long-awaited live-action debut in this summer's reboot starring Nicholas Galitzine?

item.title: HARRY POTTER Star John Lithgow Says "Inexplicable" J.K. Rowling Is "Not Really Involved" Amid Controversies
item.description: John Lithgow, who plays Professor Dumbledore in HBO's Harry Potter TV series, has somewhat condemned author J.K. Rowling's anti-trans comments and distances her from the show.
